name: vllm-rocm-halo
description: vLLM runtime for AMD Strix Halo (gfx1151) ASSEMBLED from AMD's ROCm/vllm `gfx11`-branch wheel (vllm-wheel-halo-gfx11). This is the DEFAULT halo vLLM line (repo renamed from vllm-rocm-halo-gfx11). gfx11 ships AMD's gfx1151-tuned kernels and retains FusedMoE.tp_size (AWQ MoE loads cleanly), at the cost of trailing upstream main (no DiffusionGemma; use vllm-rocm-halo-main for that). No source compile (~2 min). Rebuild the wheel pkg (vllm-rocm-halo-wheel) first when bumping the gfx11 branch or the base image.
